decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed extensions and change of use would be acceptable on a temporary basis.  
This application represents an acceptable form of temporary development, although there are unneighbourly effects and some adverse impact on the character of the area.  On balance, the development is not fully in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), C.1.2 (New religious meeting places) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.  However the use as a prayer hall can be controlled by conditions, which could not be placed on a reversion to A4 use
Condition : 2 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 30 September 2009 when the use shall cease
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall be carried on only by Shree Jalaram Seva Trust

Condition : 4 - The premises shall be used for prayer hall and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for prayer hall purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 9.00am to 9.00pm.

Condition : 6 - Within three months of the date of this permission, details of sound insulation measures for the building shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented within three months of the date on which they are approved
Condition : 7 - Three parking spaces shall be kept permanently available at the site for use by visitors and staff of the prayer hall.
Condition : 8 - The hall and side doors to the building (including the extension and portable building) shall remain closed at all times when the building is in use.
Condition : 9 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used either within the building or external to the building.

Condition : 10 - No activity shall be carried out outside the existing buildings on the site without the prior written approval of the local planning authority.  Should the applicant wish to carry out activity outside these buildings on certain festival days or for other activities, the application for council permission shall include and means to mitigate against potential harm to residents through the activities of worshippers, including traffic management and parking control measures.
Condition : 11 - An efficient and effective extraction system should be maintained at all times to deal with cooking odours so that no odour is detectable outside the premises boundary
Condition : 12 - No deliveries or collections, including refuse collection, shall take place between 9.00 pm and 07.00 am on any day and not at all on Sundays or public holidays.
Condition : 13 - The fire exit door from the kitchen shall remain shut except in cases of emergency

Condition : 14 - Informative:  The applicant is advised that, should the festival dates approved on 9 November 2004 vary each year, the prior approval of the Council is required to any festival activities which would take outside the buildings each year and it is recommended that these should be submitted under the terms of Condition 9 to the Council no later than 31 January each year.
description: Continued use after 11th September 2006 of detached outbuilding as prayer hall, retention of single storey infill extension, extraction duct and portacabin and installation of external air conditioning plant.
